authority: CEO Round 127 deep audit: 'Do not let the controller call a candidate KILLED merely because a required simulator is absent. A missing simulator can never create a cemetery entry.'
rationale: Round 126 controller used KILLED for all 5 candidates, but the kill reasons were mostly NOT_RUN gates (uninstalled simulators) and G18 (independence not verified). This conflates 'we haven't run the experiment' with 'the mechanism was contradicted.' The new state semantics separates these.

ACTIVE.definition: Investigation underway. The controller is generating experiments, executing them, and updating the hypothesis state.
ACTIVE.permission: Continue the loop. Generate next experiment per V3 acquisition.

BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_EVIDENCE.definition: All executable experiments have been run. Remaining blockers require resources not currently available (uninstalled simulators, unavailable physical data, unfinished certification). The mechanism has NOT been contradicted — it is genuinely untested at those gates.
BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_EVIDENCE.permission: Pause candidate. Move to next candidate. Resume when missing evidence becomes available.

KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE.definition: An actual executed experiment contradicted the candidate mechanism. The mechanism was tested and failed. This is a genuine scientific kill.
KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE.permission: Cemetery entry with epistemic_class appropriate to the failure (PROVEN_INVARIANT / STRONG_CONSTRAINT / MODEL_SPECIFIC / FAILURE_LESSON).

WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.definition: All applicable virtual gates passed. All executable experiments ran and supported the mechanism. All adversarial attacks exhausted. No unresolved computational contradiction remains.
WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.permission: Freeze dossier. Move to next candidate. Begin reality-gate preparation.

PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_PENDING.definition: Promoted virtual invention awaiting reality gate. Physical experiment protocol being prepared or executed.
PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_PENDING.permission: Execute physical experiment per frozen protocol. Ingest results.

machine_enforcement.rule_1_no_killed_for_missing_simulator: A gate state of NOT_RUN may NOT promote the candidate to KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE. NOT_RUN gates contribute to BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_EVIDENCE only.
machine_enforcement.rule_2_killed_requires_executed_contradi: KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE requires at least one gate that was actually executed (state = RED from execution, not NOT_RUN) AND whose RED state reflects mechanism contradiction, not implementation failure.
machine_enforcement.rule_3_implementation_vs_mechanism: Per Article XXIX, a simulator misconfiguration is implementation failure (candidate remains ACTIVE or BLOCKED), not mechanism failure (KILLED).
machine_enforcement.rule_4_blocked_not_terminal: BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_EVIDENCE is not terminal. Candidate re-enters ACTIVE state when missing evidence becomes available.
machine_enforcement.rule_5_world_class_requires_all_executab: WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION requires all gates GREEN or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION. NOT_RUN gates block promotion (candidate is BLOCKED, not WORLD_CLASS).
